versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Instacart ordering skill.

- Place grocery orders on Instacart using browser automation.
- Supports product search, reorder from order history, smart lookback (auto-suggest items based on past cadences), and nightly auto-replenishment summary.
- Requires OpenClaw browser and an authenticated Instacart account; optional support for email verification code retrieval via gog CLI.
- Includes guidance for storefront mapping, cart management (including clearing cart), reliable browser error recovery, and explicit safety checks before placing orders.
- Optimized for minimal latency by batching tool calls and snapshotting only as needed.
